reason: The plugin is primarily a local file-based session portability utility for DeepSeek Harness, enabling users to export a session tree to a ZIP-based capsule and import it back into another workspace, with the behavior described as offline and manually transferred rather than cloud-synced.

summaries.zh: 该插件支持将当前 DeepSeek Harness 会话及其子会话树导出为本地离线 Capsule（.dsh-session-share.zip），并将该文件导入到本地工作区形成新的会话副本。
summaries.en: This plugin lets you export a DeepSeek Harness session tree as a local offline `.dsh-session-share.zip` capsule and import such a capsule into a local workspace.

capabilities: Exports complete DeepSeek Harness sessions (including subagent trees and attachments) to a local `.dsh-session-share.zip` capsule
Imports session capsules from a local ZIP file into a local workspace
Creates new local session IDs on each import, producing an independent session copy
Operates as an offline file-transfer flow without built-in cloud sharing

reasons.code: README states `/share-session` creates an offline `.dsh-session-share.zip` Capsule containing the current session and referenced images.
README states `/import-session` loads a local Capsule into a selected workspace and opens the imported session.
Package metadata identifies `fflate` dependency for local ZIP handling, matching the documented capsule export/import behavior.
README notes capsules include prompts, replies, tool I/O, workspace paths, and images and can be shared manually via local file transfer.
